classification.difficultyReason: Combine two journey stages and convert minutes to hours before dividing total distance by total time.

content.prompt: Linda rode 20 km uphill, which took her an hour. She then spent 40 minutes riding downhill the same distance. What was her average speed?

answer.short:
$24\text{ km/h}$.

Divide the total distance by the total time.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Total distance}&=20+20=40\text{ km}\\\text{Total time}&=1+\frac{40}{60}=\frac{5}{3}\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{\text{total distance}}{\text{total time}}\\\text{Average speed}&=40\div\frac{5}{3}\\\text{Average speed}&=40\times\frac{3}{5}\\\text{Average speed}&=24\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$
